messages:
priya: quick heads-up — after the kernel-selection rollout (v2.3) we're seeing a small but consistent tail increase on host-side requests, mostly in tokenization + gRPC small-write overhead. attaching quick flame and a pprof snapshot in the thread. :eyes:
matt: can you paste the top callstacks? is this before or after the kv-cache patch?
priya: after both: kernel binning + kvcache shard refactor. top lines from pprof (sampled CPU):
```
10.2%  token::tokenize
8.6%   http::parse_headers
6.9%   grpc::writev (many tiny syscalls)
5.4%   kvcache::lookup (hot-shard fallback)
4.1%   kernel_selector::choose_best
```
anya: json summary from bench-run: median Latency p50=74ms (no change) p95=220ms -> 260ms (+18%) on encode+ingress paths. smallwrite count doubled for streams <256B.
ben: confirmed on my testbed — we get a lot of 1-3 writev calls per chunk after the new kernel hints. looks like fragmentation in the ingress framer now.
priya: hypothesis: kernel hinting changed token boundary alignment which increases the number of tiny frames reaching grpc layer; grpc writev now doing more syscalls instead of coalesced writes. also kvcache fallback rate increased by ~2x leading to extra lookups during preparse.
anya: what if we re-enable the old pretoken coalescer as a short-term rollback? flip by setting KERNEL_HINT_OVERRIDE=legacy in env and run a canary.
kevin: alternative: add a coalesce buffer in host-proxy to aggregate small writev buffers for a 2ms window. cheap to try (opt-in flag), doesn't touch kernel selector.
sara: i'll run a canary on a single hostpool this afternoon. priya do you have the script for the microbench?
priya: yep, run:
```
./tools/mini-overhead-bench --rounds 1000 --payload-size 120 --profile=pprof.out
# then: go tool pprof -http=:8080 pprof.out
```
bench-bot: quick CI micro-bench results (post-rollout): 6312345000 -> baseline, 6312346000 -> rollout
- baseline smallwrite rate: 0.12/wreq
- rollout smallwrite rate: 0.28/wreq
- baseline kvcache miss: 0.9%
- rollout kvcache miss: 1.8%
priya: next actions I propose:
1) canary with KERNEL_HINT_OVERRIDE=legacy (sara)
2) infra to try host-proxy coalesce flag on a canary pool (kevin/anya)
3) short-lived kvcache metrics toggle to capture per-shard miss-rate (ben)
4) if canary shows improvement, ship fast rollback for kernel hints and follow with gradual re-roll with smaller kernel hint diff

anyone object? :+1:
matt: +1 to trying host-proxy coalesce first (less invasive). can you add a quick A/B plan so we can measure cost impact? i'll help with dashboards.
anya: will wire up a Grafana panel for smallwrite rate, p95 tail, kvcache miss per shard.
kevin: i can land the coalesce flag behind feature toggle and prod-canary it today. rough impl: buffer up to 4KB or 2ms, whichever first, then single writev.
sara: kicking off canary now with legacy hint env on pool-17, will post results in ~45m.
priya: thanks all — logging here so we don't lose the context. i'll update with pprof links once sara posts. :raised_hands:
